lines.text: A small back room. Handwritten notes on the walls. A few people with phones, checking things. Nobody looks up when you enter.

Nandadasa Mahaththaya described them to you once, without naming them: 'a group of people who check things before they share them.' He was invited to join once. He did not reply to the invitation. The invitation itself took six weeks.
From now on, you can share any Uncle Sirisena message to the Skeptics Cafe before deciding what to do with it. They will check it. They will tell you what they find.
